      • setUserDefined

        @PublishedMethod
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)
public static void setUserDefined(IEcucStatePublished self,
                                                                                                boolean isUserDefined)
        Sets or removes the user-defined flag of a configuration element.
        The method setUserDefined(boolean) sets or removes the user-defined flag of a ecuc configuration element like parameters.

        Note: This method must executed inside a transaction because it modifies the model state. 

         
 MIParameterValue param = ...
 transaction {
   param.ceState.userDefined = true
 }

        Important remark:

        Generators and validation rules shall never use this method because the user only is in charge of the user-defined flags lifetime.
        Parameters:
        configElement - - module configuration, container or parameter
        isUserDefined - - the new state of the user defined flag
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no transaction is running
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - will be thrown if the specified configuration element is not a parameter, container or module configuration.
        ModelException - if the IEcucStatePublished has no valid MDF model element, e.g. the model element was already deleted.
